children: Here's a list of key deals reported across sectors this week:
Onsemi
announced a new agreement to acquire Synaptics
for $123 a share in cash, revising
that was disclosed in June. The amended agreement came after an unsolicited competing proposal.
Mattel
soared 19% after a report that the toymaker has recently received takeover interest from Authentic Brands.
Nebius
on Thursday said it has acquired Inferize to strengthen the AI company's token factory's production inference stack.
Lynas Rare Earths
said on Thursday it agreed to acquire Australian peer Meteoric Resources
in ​an all-stock deal valued at A$968M ($672M).
Walgreens private-equity owner Sycamore is near a deal to sell the U.K. pharmacy chain Boots for close to $9 billion, including debt.
Caterpillar

on Wednesday announced plans to invest about $1 billion in North Carolina to expand production of compact construction equipment, a day after the heavy-machinery maker agreed to acquire longtime Cat dealer John Fabick Tractor Co.
Hormel Foods

said it has agreed to acquire Brakebush Brothers, a value-added chicken provider, from the Brakebush family for approximately $1.055B, with the deal expected to close in the first quarter of fiscal 2027.
Advanced Micro Devices
on Monday said it would acquire World Labs, an AI model and research lab, in an all-stock transaction is valued at nearly $8.2 billion.
Nu Holdings
is reportedly in talks to acquire U.K. digital bank Monzo in a deal valued at around £8B-£10B.

title: Key deals this week: Onsemi, Mattel, Nebius, Advanced Micro Devices, and more
